Title: Implement splitbrain_get_metrics tool (aggregate metrics over MCP)
Description: Returns aggregate performance metrics from the OpenTelemetry meters: total requests, p50/p95/p99 latency by tool type, fallback rate, circuit breaker events, token usage by model. Enables CI pipelines, alerting integrations, and programmatic monitoring that cannot open the Blazor dashboard. Parameters: since? (DateTime), tool? (filter). Reads from IMetricsCollector.
